how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-alterac-mountains-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:505:obj:0: Kill 12 ⟦E1⟧ Footpads and 8 ⟦E1⟧ Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.

The assassins were never found, but through our investigations we're almost certain they were hired by the ⟦E1⟧ - a group of thieves led by villainous nobles of the now fallen kingdom of Alterac.
rows.quest:505:details:1: The ⟦E1⟧ has a camps in Sofera's Naze and Corahn's ⟦E3⟧, north and west of the ⟦E4⟧-occupied Tarren Mill. Slay the ⟦E1⟧ members you find in these camps.
rows.quest:505:progress:0: You have slain those ⟦E1⟧ thugs, I trust?
rows.quest:505:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦1⟧. Although they may still be lurking about, we hope that some of the thieves and footpads you slew were responsible for the last magistrate's death. But even if they weren't, the ⟦E1⟧ is a taint on this land and a stain on the human race.
rows.quest:96987:title: Opportunistic Education
rows.quest:96987:obj:0: Collect the Founding of ⟦E5⟧ from the City of ⟦E5⟧ for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
rows.quest:96987:details:0: Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into ⟦E5⟧ durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.
rows.quest:96987:details:2: While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.
rows.quest:96987:details:3: Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
rows.quest:96987:progress:0: Well? Didja find their library? There's gotta be somethin' good in there.
rows.quest:510:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E7⟧ to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:510:details:0: Among these documents is a list of requested supplies. These include mundane items (food, weapons, clothing) as well as more exotic gear (masks, oil, poison).
rows.quest:510:details:1: But what is most notable is the urgency of the request - these supplies were needed soon in order to undertake what is described in the document as an "important mission against ⟦E2⟧."
rows.quest:510:progress:0: ⟦2⟧, you look anxious. Is there something you wish to tell me?
rows.quest:510:completion:1: These are very troubling, ⟦3⟧. From the information in these documents, and from the ⟦E1⟧'s actions in the past, we must assume that band of cutthroats has waged war on ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:511:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E8⟧ to Loremaster Dibbs in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:511:details:0: One of the letters on this table is encrypted and inscrutable.
rows.quest:511:progress:0: Yes, ⟦4⟧? Do you have some business with me?
rows.quest:511:completion:0: What is this? Hold a moment... let me take a closer look.
rows.quest:511:completion:2: Hm, I have never before seen this ⟦E9⟧ of encryption, but I must admit that my knowledge in that area is by no means complete.
rows.quest:514:obj:0: Take the ⟦E10⟧ to Prospector Stormpike in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:514:details:0: I have a colleague in ⟦E11⟧ who may be able to help decrypt this letter. Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in ⟦E11⟧ and speak with Prospector Stormpike. Tell him I sent you and show him the letter. If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.
rows.quest:514:progress:0: Dibbs from ⟦E2⟧ sent you, did he? How is the old bookworm doing?
rows.quest:514:completion:0: Ah, encryption! A specialty of mine. Let me see here...
rows.quest:525:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E12⟧ to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:525:details:0: I decrypted the letter, but I don't know what to make of it. You found this among thieves in the Alterac foothills? Very strange...
rows.quest:525:details:1: You should take this to the magistrate of ⟦E2⟧. Although this letter is cryptic, his is the closest town to Alterac; if a ⟦E13⟧ is brewing, then he should know.
rows.quest:525:progress:0: ⟦5⟧. Have you been traveling through the foothills and mountains again? What news do you bring?
rows.quest:525:completion:1: This is translated from a letter you found in a ⟦E1⟧ encampment? This was not written by a thief, or even a noble of Alterac.
rows.quest:525:completion:2: It appears The ⟦E1⟧ has ties to another power, and I shudder to think what that might be.
rows.quest:535:obj:0: Bring a mug of ⟦E14⟧ to ⟦E15⟧ in the ⟦E1⟧ camp.
rows.quest:535:details:0: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:535:details:1: No doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some ⟦E2⟧ stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
rows.quest:535:progress:0: Did you bring me something to drink or did you just come back to finish the job?
rows.quest:535:completion:0: Given my impending death, I think I can safely say that this is the sweetest tasting thing ever... Here, take this, won't do me any good when I'm dead.
rows.quest:500:obj:0: Gather 9 ⟦E17⟧ from Crushridge ogres in the ⟦E18⟧. Bring them to Marshal Redpath in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:500:details:0: Crushridge ogres have dug an ogre mound up in the ⟦E18⟧ near the ruined city of Alterac. And my scouts tell me they've taken over those ruins as well.
rows.quest:500:details:1: We can't let them get cozy up there; if they think they're safe where they are, then their next step will be to move down into the foothills, which will put them right at our front door!
rows.quest:500:details:2: Go north to the ⟦E18⟧ and hunt ogres. Bring me the ⟦E17⟧ they carry and you will earn a nice bounty.
rows.quest:500:progress:0: ⟦6⟧, are you still hunting ogres? Do you have the knucklebones I had you gather?
rows.quest:500:completion:0: Very good, ⟦7⟧ You must have hacked through a whole mess of ogres to get all these knucklebones.
rows.quest:500:completion:1: That should keep them out of our hair. At least, for a while.
rows.quest:512:obj:0: Bring 7 Alterac ⟦E19⟧ Rings to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:512:details:0: I ⟦E20⟧ the leadership behind the ⟦E1⟧ is bent on ⟦E2⟧'s ruin. We must ⟦E21⟧ hard at these leaders before their plans are realized.

rows.quest:512:progress:0: Have you been hunting the ⟦E1⟧? Do you have those rings?
rows.quest:512:completion:0: Stripping the ⟦E1⟧ of its nobility will remove its ⟦E22⟧ to act decisively, and reduce it to nothing more than a gang of thugs.
rows.quest:522:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E24⟧ to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:522:details:0: This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb. It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.
rows.quest:522:progress:0: You look out of breath! Do you have something to report?
rows.quest:522:completion:1: That explains the latest attack on ⟦E2⟧. The ⟦E1⟧ must be after me, just as they were the last magistrate!
rows.quest:504:obj:0: Slay 10 ⟦E25⟧, then return to Marshal Redpath in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:504:details:0: Now that you've had a taste of the Crushridge ogres, I want you to really bloody their noses...
rows.quest:504:details:1: Go into the Ruins of Alterac and seek out the ⟦E25⟧. I want you to cut down a good number of them - that's the only way those brutes will learn to keep their distance from ⟦E23⟧ territory.
rows.quest:504:progress:0: You have more Warmongers to slay, ⟦9⟧. You should be up on the mountains on your task, not down here with your weapon stowed.
rows.quest:504:completion:0: Very good. Here is your reward.
rows.quest:504:completion:1: And when you were hunting those Warmongers, how did Alterac city look? It's in bad shape I would guess. Ogres are not known for their cleanliness.

rows.quest:523:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E26⟧ to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:523:details:0: The contract you recovered was signed by Baron Vardus, a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, and one known for a cold heart and brutal practices. I'm not surprised someone like the Baron was behind this.

rows.quest:523:progress:0: Baron Vardus cannot think ⟦E2⟧ will allow him to send his thugs against us with impunity. I want his head!
rows.quest:523:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦10⟧. My head rests a little easier, knowing that villain lost his.
rows.quest:537:obj:1: Bring the ⟦E28⟧ to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:537:details:0: The letter you brought me was written by a being who calls himself Nagaz, a member of the Argus Wake. I don't know what this Argus Wake is, but if they're in alliance with the ⟦E1⟧ then they must be a ⟦E13⟧.

rows.quest:537:details:2: Search in the Uplands, where the ⟦E1⟧ is strongest. It is north of Strahnbrad.
rows.quest:537:details:3: With luck, you'll find these envoys of the Argus Wake there.
rows.quest:537:progress:0: Did you find the envoys of The Argus Wake?
rows.quest:537:completion:0: Well done, ⟦11⟧. The Argus Wake does not sound like a group we want running the ⟦E1⟧.

rows.quest:551:obj:0: Take the ⟦E30⟧ to Loremaster Dibbs in ⟦E2⟧.
